data.why: the app ships its own SCImago 2025 journal table and PubMed search is live and free, so no uploads or synthetic files are needed; the scientist works entirely through PubMed search and the sidebar.

goals: Build a PubMed search (free text or block builder) for a clinical imaging question and run it with the relevant filters
Sort and filter the retrieved citations by citation count and by journal rank (SJR/quartile) to prioritize screening
Mark articles read or flagged and organize them into named reading lists while screening full texts
Generate a search strategy automatically from a Radiopaedia article's section headings (e.g. Epidemiology, MRI)
Draft a structured Radiopaedia article from the saved literature, inserting the recommended section structure and citing PubMed IDs
Run the Radiopaedia linter on the draft and export the numbered reference list and HTML for Radiopaedia's editor

review.summary: The tree follows Radiowriter's search, screen, write and lint path with sensible depth and general labels, and every one of the 11 screens I opened supports its node. Before filing it needs the missing PDF library and study window stage, honest marking that citation ranking was never shown, several label and serves_tasks fixes, and a fuller check replay of the screening and writing half.
